title: Invoice number opens in the same tab: S invoices to the work order Finance tab, P invoices to the part sale Part Requests tab
refs: specs/sbc-sales-by-customer.md Story 9 S9-R1; S9-R2; S9-R2a; S9-R2b
custom_preconds: 1. You have expanded an asset and can see at least one S invoice and (under another customer/asset if needed) one P invoice.
custom_steps:
1. Click a service (S) invoice number link and note where it opens.
  2. Go back, then click a parts (P) invoice number link and note where it opens.
custom_expected:
1. Each invoice number on a detail row is a clickable link that opens in the SAME browser tab (no new tab).
  2. A service invoice opens the associated work order's Finance tab.
  3. A parts invoice opens the associated part sale's Part Requests tab.
